name: Squall Spray
description: Send the star along the high track at head height with a sweeping overhand motion.

name: Peal Hail
description: Send the star along the low track at the knee with an underhand flick of the wrist.

name: Windborne Thinplate
description: Change stance from the high track to the low with a single sliding step.

name: Seasonhub
description: Fan stars out from the left and right hands in turn so both tracks stay full.

name: Spoketriumph
description: Slash with a held star from the high track down across the low one in a crossing stroke.

name: Squall Spoke
description: Run a blade along the star like a carriage on a rail until it falls clear of the body.

name: Millstone Peppering
description: Pin the loose trouser at the knee to a post or door with a low track star.

name: Radiance Flatpoint
description: One star from each track arrives in the same breath at head and knee.

name: Toothseal
description: Cast stars along both tracks and tie them in a lattice that the foe must cross.

name: Prismspoke
description: Both tracks close on a single plate of armor and drive their points through together.

name: Resonant Hub
description: The school's own chain of throws in which the high and low tracks pass the foe between them.

name: Tranquil Rimpoint
description: Hold a high still stance like a hawk on a pole and survey the foe's every move.

name: Fearless Sprinkle
description: Spread both arms like wings and throw with the outer hand at the widest point.

name: Pulsarhub
description: Seize the star in a talon grip and stab one spoke into a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Valiant Tippoint
description: Throw upward and let the star fall back on the foe's shoulders in a light first stoop.

name: Sovereign Centerhole
description: Hurl the star higher and heavier so it drives down on the crown of a helm.

name: Squall Bladeface
description: Wheel in a rising curve over uneven ground to reach a higher footing before the foe.

name: Lordly Centerhole
description: Spot a seam in the armor from far off and send a hardened star into it.

name: Inferno Whiz
description: Gather qi and soar a star high over a ridge to fall on a foe sheltering behind it.

name: Hailvow
description: A raised star throws a hawk shadow across the foe and freezes the guard for a heartbeat.

name: Quenched Edgeface
description: The school's final stoop in which the star falls from the full height of the watch.

name: Thunderclap Bladeface
description: Begin small with a short throw that is the first trickle of the river.

name: Wraithlike Tippoint
description: Hop between stones at the water's edge and keep the throwing hand level.

name: Pealtooth
description: Read the foe's movement like the current of a stream and mark where it will pass.

name: Scatter Banner
description: Rake a spoke across a foe who slips on wet mud at the edge of the flat.

name: Inferno Rimpoint
description: Throw from two hands along converging lines like two streams joining.

name: Prismtooth
description: Hold the forearm and star like a bar of sand that splits an oncoming rush.

name: Prism Cornerpoint
description: Skip the star off the ground like a stone off the shallows and into the legs.

name: Sprayseal
description: Flick a star through a puddle at the ford so the spray blinds the foe for a moment.

name: Sovereign Edgeface
description: Throw many stars in a swelling rush as meltwater floods a low field.

name: Guileful Hub
description: Cast a line of stars that stands like a weir across the road and turns the foe aside.

name: Bedrock Peppering
description: Hold back stars then release them all at once in a long breaking rush.

name: Inferno Sprinkle
description: The school's great throw in which stars gather overhead and fall to fill the whole hollow.

name: Toothverdict
description: The right hand states the plea with a straight star at the foe's chest.

name: Pulsar Cornerpoint
description: The left hand answers with a low star that meets the foe's dodge to the first.

name: Flatpoint Mercy
description: Tap the pace on the thigh like a gavel and keep a sure count of the foe's steps.

name: Haemalwhiz
description: Poke a spoke at the guard again and again to find the place where it weakens.

name: Deluge Edgeface
description: Turn a blow aside with a star and answer in the same motion with the second hand.

name: Scatter Troth
description: Pin a long sleeve to the floor so the foe stands bound like one served a writ.

name: Gloomspray
description: Hold a steady volley across the path so that no one dares step past the line.

name: Unrivaled Spoke
description: A hardened star flies with the finality of a verdict through the foe's raised guard.

name: Hubtroth
description: Cast stars in a ring around a chosen spot and bind it so only the judged may stand within.

name: Pulsar Thinplate
description: Two hands throw as one in a last strike that no guard may set aside.

name: Toothcrown
description: The school's closing throw in which two stars circle the foe and then fall as one.

name: Peerless Whiz
description: Fix the eyes on one point like the polar star and throw along that line without drift.

name: Reminiscence Thinplate
description: Map the foe's position in the field as a chart of fixed points before the first throw.

name: Haemal Spray
description: Cut the wrist of a reaching hand with one precise spoke point.

name: Vigorspoke
description: Circle the foe in a steady orbit while keeping the face turned toward him.

name: Pulsar Sprinkle
description: Send two stars wheeling around each other so they strike from different sides.

name: Devout Bladeface
description: Strike aside a thrust with a hard downward star that burns across the blade.

name: Pealhub
description: Throw a star that trails a thin tail of qi along its low line.

name: Prism Whiz
description: Throw straight up to the highest point and let the star drop onto the mark.

name: Subtle Spoke
description: Hang stars overhead in the field in a fixed figure that falls on anyone who passes under.

name: Demolition Hail
description: Hurl many stars so they streak down in a bright shower across the ground.

name: Venomspoke
description: Cover the foe's guard with a screen of stars so that it fails at the decisive moment.

name: Splendid Hail
description: The school's grand figure of stars released together across the whole basin at once.

name: Inferno Hub
description: Open with a single star thrown into the empty air above the foe's head.

name: Peal Rimpoint
description: Draw one deep breath into the Core and sight level along the arm.

name: Delugespoke
description: Slide into the empty space beside the foe where no guard has been set.

name: Squallhail
description: Feed the star from the Core as it flies and keep it fast to the very end.

name: Spokeseal
description: Spin the star in a small hollow ring that draws a blow into empty air.

name: Commanding Spray
description: A pulse from the Core drives the star through a hem and into stone.

name: Dauntless Cornerpoint
description: Harden the point with the Core's force and drive it through a shield face.

name: Parity Tippoint
description: Cast stars into a hollow net that closes around the foe like a drawn purse.

name: Dunewhiz
description: Burst a fan of stars outward from the Core's push and cover a wide arc.

name: Demolition Centerhole
description: The school's high rite of throwing in which the sky empties itself of stars over the hollow.

name: Spokeedict
description: Swear the first oath of the throw and loose the star level without hesitation.

name: Revelation Flatpoint
description: Taste the wind on the lips and judge from its cool or warm edge where it blows.

name: Scatter Voyage
description: Pivot on the heel with the gust so the body turns in one clean beat.

name: Prism Rimpoint
description: Skim the star along a sworn straight line low over the stones.

name: Noble Peppering
description: Hook a spoke behind the knee of a foe and drag him off the plateau line.

name: Squall Edgeface
description: Turn the star against a cut and let the sworn guard carry the blade past.

name: Spokeverdict
description: Ride a lane of wind with a hardened star to break the guard on arrival.

name: Snaring Thinplate
description: Cast stars along a gust line and hide them in the grass for anyone who walks there.

name: Whizedict
description: Store a gust against the palm and release it all behind the star in one stroke.

name: Lordly Scatter
description: The school's signature release made at the first breath of the gust and kept to its mark.

name: Dauntless Whiz
description: Skim the star across hard packed ground so it rings off every stone.

name: Reminiscence Cornerpoint
description: Fix the gaze on the horizon line and judge the range of anything standing against it.

name: Haemal Centerhole
description: Scrape a spoke along the rock and up across the foe who braces against it.

name: Soundless Hail
description: Take a long reaching stride across flat ground to arrive at throwing range at once.

name: Pulsar Tippoint
description: Skim a star through dry grass so the foe hears it only when it arrives.

name: Inferno Peppering
description: Throw from the skyline so the foe below cannot see the star against the glare.

name: Sacrosanct Bladeface
description: Take the blow on the outer edge of the star and step off the line.

name: Thrall Hub
description: Throw a star through a banner and into its staff so the carrier cannot raise it.

name: Bedrock Spray
description: Hold a rise and rain stars down on any force that tries to climb it.

name: Hub Reliquary
description: Scatter stars across the open flat and set each one point up on the stone.

name: Evanescent Sprinkle
description: Blur across the open ground and throw from a place that seemed too far to reach.

name: Heroic Centerhole
description: The school's crowning volley held without a break for as long as the oath is kept.

name: Valiant Sprinkle
description: Throw level along one line and keep the arm moving on it after release.

name: Spokemercy
description: Breathe low and steady and keep the bearing from slipping as the foe shifts.

name: Whizvoyage
description: Move sideways along the held line so the foe stays on the same bearing.

name: Thunderclap Cornerpoint
description: Throw a skimming star then adjust the next one by where the first fell.

name: Bedrock Bladeface
description: Hook a spoke along the foe's arm so the arm points where the thrower wishes.

name: Squall Flatpoint
description: Hold the line with the star so a blow glances off it and onto the ground.

name: Hailpledge
description: Throw two stars on crossing bearings that pin a cloak at the point they meet.

name: Steel Edgeface
description: Send a hardened star along the held line through a gap no wider than itself.

name: Sigil Spoke
description: Lay stars in a thin line across the foe's expected bearing so his stride meets them.

name: Radiance Hail
description: Flash down the held bearing and drive a star home at the end of the line.

name: Paramount Spoke
description: The school's single throw along a perfect bearing that the school holds above all others.

name: Magnificent Scatter
description: Throw flat into open wind with the wrist braced against its push.

name: Reminiscence Rimpoint
description: Count the steady beats of a gale and mark the quiet that falls between them.

name: Silken Spray
description: Slide with feet wide apart over bare ground so no gust can unbalance the stance.

name: Prism Tippoint
description: Throw against a twisting wind that coils the star in a long curve around its target.

name: Consecrated Flatpoint
description: Turn an open palm and star together to slap a thrust off its line.

name: Bedrock Thinplate
description: Throw a long volley that rides each gust and keeps its pace.

name: Steelspoke
description: Drive a star down a narrow channel of wind so it flies like a short spear.

name: Entropy Peppering
description: Throw stars upward into the open wind and let them rain down across the yard.

name: Radiance Cornerpoint
description: Ride the leading edge of a gale with the star and arrive before the sound does.

name: Matchless Bladeface
description: The school's great cast that lets the open gale carry stars across the whole field.

name: Prism Sprinkle
description: Throw the first star like the first heavy drop that falls from a darkening cloud.

name: Spokebenison
description: Feel the air tighten before a gust and mark the moment it will break.

name: Quenched Rimpoint
description: Slash with a spoke from behind a snapping cloak that hides the hand.

name: Sprayboon
description: Run in short bursts through driving rain and settle for each throw.

name: Peerless Tippoint
description: Throw a star that splits its path around an obstacle and joins again beyond it.

name: Faithful Hub
description: Turn into a sudden squall and let its push carry a blow away.

name: Seasonhail
description: Fan stars at the edge of cover like hail at the edge of a storm.

name: Authoritative Thinplate
description: Pin a flapping sleeve to a post in the squall so the foe is held in place.

name: Thunderous Centerhole
description: Throw stars in a long line that advances like the edge of a storm front.

name: Subtle Flatpoint
description: Seed the ground with stars that rise at a footfall and ring like struck bells.

name: Pulsarspoke
description: Wait in the calm at the center of the storm then drive one star through the foe.

name: Fearless Whiz
description: The school's final rite in which the whole storm is bound to the thrown stars and loosed.

name: Thunderclap Edgeface
description: Sight a far peak behind the target and throw as if the star must reach it.

name: Peal Spoke
description: Breathe in time with a distant peak and let the mind reach as far as the throw.

name: Vigorhub
description: Step along a cliff edge with eyes on the far side and not on the drop.

name: Splendid Scatter
description: Draw wind from the Core into the star so it bends far beyond its natural arc.

name: Venerable Tippoint
description: Spin the star against an incoming strike and send it wheeling out and away.

name: Fettering Spray
description: Pin a far figure's sleeve to a distant post with one long throw.

name: Gloom Hail
description: Skim a long volley across a wide gap and keep it fed from the Core.

name: Exalted Thinplate
description: Wrap the star in the Core's gale so it pierces a shield at the end of a long flight.

name: Guileful Flatpoint
description: Cast stars far down the lane an enemy must take and hide them in the dust.

name: Pulsar Rimpoint
description: Flash across the gap to the far side and pierce the foe before the dust settles.

name: Tenet Whiz
description: The school's long sworn run of throws carried past the edge by wind and Core together.
